summary: Create 154 campaign-level negative keywords across Patio and Pavers covering twelve confirmed wrong-service families. All PHRASE. No bare noun the account sells.

collision_testing.tested_against_own_keyword_texts: all 461 positive keywords in Patio and Pavers, ENABLED and PAUSED
collision_testing.tested_against_protected_search_terms: every KEEP, WATCH, UNRESOLVED and UNCLASSIFIED term in the corpus

why_this_is_needed_despite_1452_existing: Every existing campaign negative on Patio and Pavers is BROAD (420 and 416), and the linked 'General List' shared set is 1,109 BROAD of 1,111. A BROAD negative only blocks a query containing ALL of its words, so 'asphalt paving' never blocked 'asphalt contractor near me'. This plan is PHRASE throughout.
note_on_blocked_credits: The plan blocks 3 historic credits on purpose: one sealcoating, one asphalt and one paver-sealing term. All three are outside both work orders. Paver sealing has its own PAUSED campaign in this account (23914857298).
risk: A negative that is too broad blocks real demand. Mitigated by the collision test above: any candidate touching a live or paused own keyword, or any protected search term, was rejected rather than softened.
rollback: Remove the created campaign_criterion rows. No other object changes.
validation: local preflight then google-ads validate_only in batches
dependencies: PLAN-SLM-KW-1 must execute and read back FIRST. The 'asphalt' PHRASE negative on Pavers collides with the seven keywords that plan pauses.
